setting: 別れてしばらく経った二人が、カフェで久しぶりに会う
lyrics:
I'm so glad you made time to see me
How's life? Tell me, how's your family?
I haven't seen them in a while
You've been good, busier than ever
We small talk, work and the weather
Your guard is up and I know why

Because the last time you saw me
Is still burned in the back of your mind
You gave me roses and I left them there to die

So, this is me swallowing my pride
Standin' in front of you sayin', "I'm sorry for that night"
And I go back to December all the time
It turns out freedom ain't nothing but missin' you
Wishin' I'd realized what I had when you were mine
I go back to December, turn around and make it alright
I go back to December all the time

These days, I haven't been sleeping
Stayin' up, playing back myself leavin'
When your birthday passed and I didn't call
Then I think about summer, all the beautiful times
I watched you laughin' from the passenger side
And realized I loved you in the fall

And then the cold came, the dark days
When fear crept into my mind
You gave me all your love and all I gave you was goodbye

So, this is me swallowing my pride
Standin' in front of you, sayin', "I'm sorry for that night"
And I go back to December all the time
It turns out freedom ain't nothing but missin' you
Wishin' I'd realized what I had when you were mine
I go back to December, turn around and change my own mind
I go back to December all the time

I miss your tanned skin, your sweet smile
So good to me, so right
And how you held me in your arms that September night
The first time you ever saw me cry
Maybe this is wishful thinkin'
Probably mindless dreaming
But if we loved again, I swear I'd love you right
I'd go back in time and change it, but I can't
So, if the chain is on your door, I understand

But this is me swallowing my pride
Standin' in front of you, sayin', "I'm sorry for that night"
And I go back to December
It turns out freedom ain't nothing but missin' you
Wishin' I'd realized what I had when you were mine
I go back to December, turn around and make it alright
I go back to December, turn around and change my own mind
I go back to December all the time

All the time

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Thanks for making time to see me.
sentences.displayHtml: Thanks for making time to see me.

sentences.text: I know this probably wasn't easy.
sentences.displayHtml: I know this probably wasn't easy.

conversation.japanese: 会う時間を作ってくれてありがとう。簡単なことじゃなかったと思う。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I wasn't sure I should come, but I wanted to hear what you had to say.
sentences.displayHtml: I wasn't sure I should come, but I wanted to hear what you had to say.

conversation.japanese: 来るべきか迷ったけど、何を言うつもりなのか聞きたかった。

sentences.text: How's life?
sentences.displayHtml: How's life?

sentences.text: How's your family doing?
sentences.displayHtml: How's your family doing?

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: They're fine.
sentences.displayHtml: They're fine.

sentences.text: We don't have to pretend this is just normal catch-up.
sentences.displayHtml: We don't have to pretend this is just normal catch-up.

conversation.japanese: 元気だよ。ただの近況報告みたいに話さなくていい。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I know.
sentences.displayHtml: I know.

sentences.text: Your guard is up, and I understand why.
sentences.displayHtml: Your guard is up, and I understand why.

conversation.japanese: わかってる。警戒してるのも、理由はわかる。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: The last time we talked, you walked away like it didn't matter.
sentences.displayHtml: The last time we talked, you walked away like it didn't matter.

conversation.japanese: 最後に話したとき、君は何でもないみたいに去っていった。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: It mattered.
sentences.displayHtml: It mattered.

sentences.text: I just acted like freedom would feel better than missing you.
sentences.displayHtml: I just acted like freedom would feel better than missing you.

conversation.japanese: 大事だったよ。ただ、あなたを恋しく思うより自由の方が楽だと思い込んでた。

sentences.text: And was it?
sentences.displayHtml: And was it?

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: No.
sentences.displayHtml: No.

sentences.text: I kept replaying that night and wishing I had understood what I had.
sentences.displayHtml: I kept replaying that night and wishing I had understood what I had.

conversation.japanese: 違う。あの夜のことを何度も思い返して、失ってから大切さに気づいた。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I gave you everything I could back then.
sentences.displayHtml: I gave you everything I could back then.

conversation.japanese: あの頃、僕はできるだけのものを渡したつもりだった。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I know.
sentences.displayHtml: I know.

sentences.text: And all I gave you was goodbye when you deserved more than that.
sentences.displayHtml: And all I gave you was goodbye when you deserved more than that.

conversation.japanese: わかってる。それなのに私は、もっとちゃんと向き合うべきだったのに別れを選んだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: So why are you saying this now?
sentences.displayHtml: So why are you saying this now?

conversation.japanese: それを今さらどうして言うの？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Because this is me swallowing my pride.
sentences.displayHtml: Because this is me swallowing my pride.

sentences.text: I'm sorry for how I left, and for the silence after.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm sorry for how I left, and for the silence after.

conversation.japanese: プライドを飲み込んで、ちゃんと伝えたいから。あんなふうに去ったことも、その後ずっと黙っていたことも、ごめん。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Part of me wanted to hear that.
sentences.displayHtml: Part of me wanted to hear that.

sentences.text: Part of me is still hurt.
sentences.displayHtml: Part of me is still hurt.

conversation.japanese: そう言ってほしかった自分もいる。でも、まだ傷ついてる自分もいる。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I don't expect you to open the door right away.
sentences.displayHtml: I don't expect you to open the door right away.

sentences.text: If it stays closed, I'll understand.
sentences.displayHtml: If it stays closed, I'll understand.

conversation.japanese: すぐに心を開いてほしいなんて思ってない。閉じたままでも、私は受け止める。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I need time.
sentences.displayHtml: I need time.

sentences.text: I can't just go back because you regret it now.
sentences.displayHtml: I can't just go back because you regret it now.

conversation.japanese: 時間が必要だよ。君が後悔してるからって、すぐ戻れるわけじゃない。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I know.
sentences.displayHtml: I know.

sentences.text: I can't change it, but I wanted to finally say it right.
sentences.displayHtml: I can't change it, but I wanted to finally say it right.

conversation.japanese: わかってる。起きたことは変えられない。ただ、今度こそちゃんと言いたかった。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Then maybe we start there.
sentences.displayHtml: Then maybe we start there.

sentences.text: Not back together.
sentences.displayHtml: Not back together.

sentences.text: Just honest.
sentences.displayHtml: Just honest.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、そこから始めよう。よりを戻すんじゃなくて、まず正直に。
